summary: Trace sprite font 003 into TrueType fonts
author: pm
body:
Recreate sprite font 003 (staged/client/sprites/interface/sprite_fonts/003.png: three sizes, large, medium and small, each ASCII 32-126, frames 0-94 / 95-189 / 190-284 in its manifest) as TrueType fonts. User, 2026-11-25: "Can you send an agent to recreate the ttf's from these bitmap fonts? ... Following the edges at the center using proper font flowing techniques."

Approach:
- Trace each glyph's outline through the pixel-edge centre line (sub-pixel contour at 50% coverage), not the pixel staircase.
- Smooth it and fit quadratic curves, giving proper TrueType outlines with consistent direction, sensible point counts, and no self-intersections.
- Keep each frame's advance and its baseline from the pivot.
- Build one TTF per size with fontTools, with metrics that put the cap height and baseline where the bitmap has them.

**Done when:**
- three TTFs exist (large, medium, small);
- each renders the damage texts, "Poisoned" and coordinates close to the bitmap at its native pixel size, measured per glyph (IoU against the bitmap, with the mean reported) and shown side by side;
- the outlines pass a fontTools validation.

Shipping and wiring them into the client is a separate decision. The glyphs are Helbreath's own 1999 art, the same art we already ship as a sprite.

**Result, 2026-11-25:** traced into three TTFs (large, medium, small), 94 inked glyphs each, IoU 1.000 for every glyph against the bitmap (exact rasteriser and FreeType unhinted). Caveat: FreeType's auto-hinter (which SFML may force for unhinted fonts; unverified) shifts some glyphs by a pixel at 16 px (worst IoU 0.22-0.49); the fix is adding minimal hinting programs when the fonts are wired in. Files: .claude/scratch/editor/font_trace/ (hb_sprite3_{large,medium,small}.ttf, trace_font.py, compare.png, outlines.png, report.json). Waiting on the user: look at compare.png and decide whether to ship them.

**HD pass, 2026-11-25:** redrew sprite font 003 as clean outlines in hb_sprite3_hd_{large,medium,small}.ttf (.claude/scratch/editor/font_trace_hd/). Method: pass 1's trace, with corners only at real stem, bar and cap ends; on-curve anchors with axis tangents at every flat-run extremum; one fixed-tangent cubic per span, then quadratics. IoU is a floor (0.93, scored with a 0.06 coverage margin), not the objective. Metrics are identical to pass 1 (unitsPerEm, advances, cmap, ascender, descender, cap and x heights); only usWinAscent/usWinDescent shrink by 4-16 units because the outlines no longer overshoot. IoU at 16 px through FreeType's default path, mean/min: large 0.978/0.926, medium 0.980/0.931, small 0.991/0.938; no glyph is below 0.85. Validation: 0 problems (direction, self-intersections, lsb), no necks, identical round trip. Points 2872/3382/2690 vs pass 1's 3493/4101/3162; wobble proxy 368/480/384 vs 558/656/468. Minimal hinting: no-op fpgm, prep and glyph programs, plus gasp (grayscale, no grid-fit). Caveat: if SFML 3.0.2 forces FT_LOAD_FORCE_AUTOHINT (unverified: Font.cpp is not vendored), the bytecode does not help and medium/small minimums drop to 0.23/0.08. Overrides: large A gets a triangular counter, large a a 0.99 floor. Previews: compare_hd.png, outlines_hd.png, sample_4x.png, facets_check.png. Waiting on the user to look.
